segments.text: Hello Myself Ishita Bhatia, I am third year Chemical Engineering student at IIT Rurki
So what are your general opinions on dogs and campus?
I fear of dogs and after every hostel in the campus I have a lot of problems with them.
I fear that if we go to any area like Sarojini or Himalaya and even Mackemab also has many dogs
I was scared to go there.
Have you ever had any personal experience like being bitten or chased by a dog?
Yes, once I came across the civil department and there were 10-12 dogs.
I was going quietly from side but two or three of them surrounded me
I was scared and people didn't even come around.
What happened after that?
After that, I called the gardener but he heard a voice.
There were no gardeners in front of the electrical department
and there weren't any gardeners at the back of civil department.
I think many people are scared of dogs on campus.
So have your feelings changed after that incident?
I used to not fear this much but if it happened then I am already scared.
Because there were a lot of groups of dogs covering like 7-8 people,
If he was 1-2, then pass him somewhere from the side.
But there are many dogs on campus.
Did you provoke that dog?
Or did she attack randomly?
She attacked randomly.
I think it was a cup of coffee in my hand
so she was chasing something.
But normally I would pass her by talking to her on call
and suddenly 2-3 dogs were chasing me.
